name: remote-dev
note: remote-dev is consumed as an external checkout, not a submodule and not a vendored copy. The repository is private; a private third .gitmodules entry would break `git submodule update --init --recursive` for every public cloner. The scaffold locates the checkout through VAWS_REMOTE_DEV_ROOT or the default path above, registers .agents/lib/vaws_remote_dev_plugin.py as the endpoint resolver, and points the substrate at the Ascend runtime environment file. Bump `commit` deliberately; `remote_dev.py status` reports drift.
